integrity: Claims of sharpness are supported by a complete analytic Laplacian and discrete-concavity argument. The included finite tests are corroborative, not a substitute for the infinite proof. No independent review is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted finite simple complete multipartite graphs; real edge signals with their maximum norm. Excludes arbitrary graphs, nonunit conductances, and routing competitive ratios. A stronger implicit prior transfer-current theorem remains a priority risk.
title: Sharp edgewise electrical projection norms and extremal multipartite networks
